char foo(int n, char c)
{
    while (n--)
    {
        std::cout.put(c);
    }
    std::cout.put('\n');
    return c;
}

int main()
{
    using namespace std;
    using namespace chrono;

    auto ft1 = async(launch::async,foo, 1000,'A');
    auto ft2 = async(launch::async,foo, 1000,'B');
    auto ft3 = async(launch::async,foo, 1000,'C');
    auto ft4 = async(launch::async,foo, 1000,'D');
    cout << ft1.get() << ft2.get() << ft3.get() << ft4.get();

}

int sum_square(int a, int b)
{
    return a * a + b * b;
}

int main()
{
    using namespace std;
    using namespace chrono;

    packaged_task<int(int, int)> task(sum_square);

    auto ftr = task.get_future();

    thread t{ move(task),5,9 };

    cout << ftr.get() << '\n';
    

}

void ftask()
{
    std::cout << "Executing task...\n";
}

int main()
{
    using std::cout;

    std::packaged_task<void()> task1;
    std::packaged_task<void()> task2(ftask);

    cout << "task1 is " << (task1.valid() ? "valid" : "empty") << '\n';
    cout << "task2 is " << (task2.valid() ? "valid" : "empty") << '\n';

    //// Move task2 into task3
    std::packaged_task<void()> task3 = std::move(task2);

    cout << "After moving task2 to task3:\n";
    cout << "task2 is " << (task2.valid() ? "valid" : "empty") << '\n';
    cout << "task3 is " << (task3.valid() ? "valid" : "empty") << '\n';
}
task1 is empty
task2 is valid
After moving task2 to task3:
task2 is empty
task3 is valid
